retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 15 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1369412868, files the uprising under "the internal resistance to apartheid" and argues it out of the Bantu Education policy and the Afrikaans-medium decree, forward to the condemnation of the apartheid government by other states and to the Transkei bantustan of October 1976. The only South African record this atlas holds is the Second Boer War of 1899, and it holds nothing after that. The article names neither that war nor the Angolan and Mozambican independences of 1975, which are the records here a reader might expect it to reach. It waits on any South African record of the apartheid period.

title: Soweto uprising
summary: Wikidata item Q153081, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of demonstrations and protests led by black school children in South Africa". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
